Red Lentil Soup (vegan)

Ingredients:
200 g red lentils
1-2 carrots, diced
1 onion
1 l vegetable stock
1 tsp ground cumin
olive oil
salt to taste
pepper to taste

Fry the onion and carrots in a little olive oil. Add the cumin, lentils and stock. Simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft, then blend and season with salt and pepper.
